messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a tf apply for tenant-split + ipset change in tonight's change window (02:00 UTC). Need deploybot canary, provider pin to `hashicorp/aws@~> 4.72`, and an escape hatch in case provider upgrade causes drift. `terraform plan` looks clean but shows 2 route changes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot queued a canary run (id: cb-9832) for 1708302800 in us-west2. Preflight checks will run now.

maria: Can we split the apply? network module first, then iam/service-account rotation. If network fails, rollback network only and hold iam.

alex: Yes — plan: 1) apply `module.network` (canary subset: tenant-a-canary), validate BGP/egress and LB routing, 2) if stable, apply `module.iam` which includes SA rotation. Rollback playbook: https://internal/release/rollback-playbooks/infra-apply (see 'network-evac' subsection).

sam: Heads-up: service account `infra-apply-runner` will be rotated during the iam step. For safety add `--auto-approve=false` on the iam apply and require a manual ack before commit.

deploy-bot: Preflight results: terraform fmt ✅, terraform validate ✅, provider pin detected ✅, plan flagged 1 DNS-related change (aws_route53_record). See plan snippet in artifacts.

alex: ```
Plan: - aws_route53_record.lb (replace)
      ~ name: "app.prod" -> "app.prod"
  + aws_route53_record.lb (create)
Potential short DNS flap during cutover. We'll implement a traffic-wedge via weighted records and monitor health checks.
```

natalie: I'll be oncall for the window. If DNS flaps > 60s or health-check error rate spikes, abort and rollback to previous record. @alex, please set a flag so deploybot blocks the second apply until manual confirmation.

alex: Added run metadata: `deploybot: set abort_on_dns_flap=true` and `manual_iam_ack_required=true`. Also drafting release notes: "infra: provider aws pinned to 4.72; tenant-split canary; traffic-wedge for DNS cutover."

ops-oncall: Noted. If deploybot reports `canary:fail` open a P1 and follow network-evac checklist. I'll be reachable via phone.

deploy-bot: Canary run started (1708302790). Logs: applying module.network (tenant-a-canary) ... patching ipset, updating route tables. Preflight artifact: s3://infra-artifacts/cb-9832/plan.txt

maria: If canary shows transient route flaps but LB health checks remain healthy, we observe for 10 minutes before promoting. If flaps persist > 2 minutes then rollback network only.

alex: :thumbsup: Will post final release notes after the run. Run tags: `change_window:02:00-03:00 UTC`, `rollback_playbook:network-evac`, `canary_id:cb-9832`, `manual_iam_ack_required`.
